title: Transfer: Assembly Defect Drift Detection
goal: Use monthly defect-rate records for a flagship electronics assembly line to determine whether quality is improving or worsening over time, and output the slope, p-value, and direction in a single summary file.
skillBenefitRationale: This moves the skill into manufacturing quality control, where the only essential work is fitting and interpreting a long-term trend on an operational metric without forecasting or root-cause analysis.
